decisions.executionNote: Holder is in right workspace; begin right-hand side-grasp approach, turning inward gradually while maintaining elbow continuity.
Continue right approach from outside the holder, with open jaws and gradual yaw alignment.
Previous chunk rejected without motion. Replan at smaller translation and yaw increments to preserve joint continuity.
Align right jaws beside the upright holder, lowering to side-grasp height while staying in right workspace.
Replan from interrupted pose. Move outward around holder before lowering; correct wrist tilt with smaller increments.

Close slowly on holder side and make a small lift to inspect retention; holder orientation is uncertain after contact.
No retention visible; holder is on its side. Open and lift clear, beginning a downward-facing recovery approach.
Pitch change was rejected at wrist singularity. Lift and ease yaw away before introducing very small downward rotation.
Rotate toward a top-down grasp of the fallen holder while lifting clear and advancing slowly; monitor wrist continuity.
Continue downward-facing recovery approach above the holder; leave fingers open until centered on its body.
Center over fallen holder and align jaws across its width, bringing gripper nearly vertical before final descent.
Adjust jaw direction perpendicular to the holder's diagonal body and descend slowly; grasp has not yet been established.
Close around the holder body and lift a short distance to check retention visually before attempting to right it.
Holder moved with the gripper. Keep closed and carry inward/upward to a safer right-side staging position; inspect its uprightness.
Carry retained holder toward the center of the right workspace. Begin left-arm downward approach to the cyan pen, keeping arms separated.
Stage the holder near the midline without crossing arms; continue left downward approach above cyan pen.
Align left jaws across cyan pen near its capped end and descend, holding the staged holder stationary.
Fine-center cyan pen between left jaws, correct its in-plane angle, then close without lifting yet. Right hand stays closed on holder.
Lift cyan pen clear of the table with left jaws closed, then start tipping its cap upward. Keep the holder steady.
Cyan pen is retained. Lift and rotate it cap-up in clear space before translating toward the held holder.
Turn the retained pen upright while bringing the left wrist toward the central handoff region above the holder.
Finish orienting cyan pen vertically and align its lower end over the held holder, staying above the right hand.
Hands contacted and pen retention is uncertain. Separate by retracting/lifting left and lowering the holder slightly forward before reassessing.
Cyan pen slipped to the table. Lower holder toward support for a side regrasp that leaves its opening unobstructed; retract left arm.
Release the supported holder and raise the right hand clear to inspect its orientation before a side regrasp.
Holder is visibly lying on its side. Regrasp its body from above, then explicitly rotate its long axis upright before inserting pens.
Close on holder body and lift clear of the table before rotating its long axis upward.
Rotate the retained holder from its horizontal long axis toward upright, lifting throughout; this also brings the right grip around to its side.
Continue righting the holder while beginning a high, open-jaw left approach to the purple pen.
Finish righting the holder and lower its rim to a safer insertion height. Continue left orientation above purple pen.
Holder is now visibly upright with a side grip. Finish downward alignment over purple pen and descend with jaws open.
Fine-center purple pen in the left jaws, descend to its sides and close; keep upright holder stationary.
Relieve table contact, recenter the purple pen and reclose slightly higher; make a short lift to check grasp.
Lift the grasped purple pen into clearance and rotate toward cap-up orientation while keeping the holder upright.
Continue turning purple pen upright in clear space and approach the held cup from above-left.
Complete upright pen orientation and align its lower end over the unobstructed holder mouth, remaining above the rim.
Lower the purple pen into the mouth with a small centering correction; retain grip until its lower end is visibly inside.
Purple pen is visibly inside the holder; seat it slightly deeper, release, and withdraw the left hand without disturbing the upright holder.
Purple remains inserted after release. Move left hand clear toward the white pen and begin rotating into a downward grasp.
Continue open-jaw descent and orientation above the white pen; maintain the right side grip on the upright holder.
Finish aligning the left gripper downward across the white pen before the final shallow descent.
Move toward the white pen's thicker upper body, lower a short distance, and close for pickup.
Lift and retract the white pen from the far table edge, beginning its cap-up rotation only after clearance.
White pen slipped during lift. Reopen and return above its shifted middle section for a deeper, centered grasp.
Fine-center on white pen's thicker middle, align the jaws vertically and close at table pickup height.
Lift the centered white pen and retract from full reach; begin upright rotation after table clearance while keeping both grips closed.
White pen remains retained. Rotate toward upright and bring it above-left of the held cup with clearance.
Finish bringing white pen upright and align its tip above the open side of the holder, clear of the purple pen.
Correct white pen slightly left and lower its tip into the holder, keeping grip until insertion is visually confirmed.
Seat the white pen slightly deeper, release inside the holder, and withdraw left hand upward-left.
White and purple remain in the upright holder. Move left hand clear toward the black pen and begin downward orientation.
Continue orienting downward and approach above the black pen with open jaws; keep the filled holder stable.
Replan from continuity interruption: lower and slightly retract before finishing downward rotation, using smaller angular increments.
Finish vertical jaw alignment above the black pen and descend to grasping height with small continuous steps.
Center the black pen between the left jaws, close and lift a short distance to verify retention.
Black pen is retained between the jaws. Lift and retract for clearance, then begin rotating it upright.
Continue rotating retained black pen upright while moving toward the holder with ample rim clearance.
Finish upright black-pen orientation and align above the open front portion of the holder, keeping clear of the inserted pens.
Move the black pen tip slightly forward toward the holder opening and lower cautiously, maintaining closed jaws.
Lower black pen through the front of the opening, slightly away from the white pen, retaining grip until seated.
Release the black pen inside the holder and withdraw. Begin moving the held cup aside to clear access to the fallen cyan pen.
Three pens are retained in the holder. Move it aside while preparing an inclined left-hand approach to cyan without crossing the arms.
Complete the oblique cyan-pen approach from the left side, lowering open jaws while the right hand holds the filled cup clear.
Cyan pen is centered in the oblique approach. Lower jaws to its sides and close while holding the cup steady.
Lift and retract cyan pen with closed jaws. Begin compensating its oblique grasp toward cap-up while returning the holder toward insertion staging.
Cyan is retained. Continue its cap-up rotation in clearance while restoring the holder to the central staging position.
Bring cyan toward vertical despite the inclined grasp and approach above the remaining opening; lower only while maintaining clearance.
Finish vertical cyan alignment, aim for the remaining right-side space, and close the vertical gap by gently lowering pen and raising holder.
Replan from continuity interruption with no further wrist tilt. Nudge cyan toward the open slot and raise the holder gently around its lower end.
Hold cyan fixed and bring the upright holder up another small increment until its lower end enters the remaining slot.
Nudge cyan away from the black pen toward the open slot and raise the holder slightly farther around its lower end.
Cyan lower end appears within the crowded mouth. Release gently and withdraw left hand upward-left to inspect whether all pens settle inside.
Cyan is not yet seated and may be resting on the open fingers. Retract left hand laterally clear and allow it to settle before reassessing.
Cyan fell outside the holder. Restore left wrist away from its limit and gently correct the holder's visible lean while keeping the three inserted pens secure.
Cyan has settled in the left workspace. Approach from above for a straighter grasp while lowering the held cup to a safer insertion height.
Replan from the one-step prefix with smaller wrist increments, easing away from the wrist limit before completing the downward approach.
Continue a straight overhead approach to cyan in the left workspace. Lower the held cup and gently reduce its lean.
Continue downward alignment above cyan while centering over its body; keep the three inserted pens secure and gently level the holder.
